changelog: Interactions are logged with date and time (`datetime-local`), so a day's entries list in the order they happened; day-only rows keep reading as their day instead of a made-up "01:00". Follow-ups take an optional time of day (`nextActionTime`, `HH:MM` wall time) in the follow-up panel and the hand-off dialog, shown beside the day and ordering the sales calendar; due/overdue stay per calendar day (#3901).

en: Log interactions with date and time — entries of the same day now appear in the order they happened.
Follow-ups can have an optional time of day.
tr: Etkileşimler tarih ve saatle kaydediliyor — aynı günün kayıtları artık gerçek sırasıyla listeleniyor.
de: Interaktionen werden mit Datum und Uhrzeit erfasst — Einträge desselben Tages erscheinen jetzt in ihrer tatsächlichen Reihenfolge.
Wiedervorlagen können eine optionale Uhrzeit haben.
